name: Kyon
source:
Age: 16-17
Occupation: High School Student

Kyon is the main protagonist of the series and primary narrator. He is the second person to join the SOS Brigade, and unintentionally gave [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url] the idea to form the club. He is the "fourth seat" of the group. He is the only member of the group who is "normal", having no special abilities at all.

Age: 16-17

Kyon is the main protagonist of the series and primary narrator.
